user.title: Connect to the access portal
user.description: Enter the portal address and the one-time invite code you received from the portal administrator.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the portal. Check the address and your internet connection.
error.invalid_invite: The invite code is wrong, expired or already used.
error.invalid_url: The address must start with https://
error.portal_error: The portal returned an unexpected error.

user.title: New guest panel
user.description: The guest gets a link and a PIN to control the chosen entities for the chosen time. You will set up each entity in the next steps.

data_description.title: Shown to the guest, e.g. Access for Mark.
data_description.time_from: Access hours on each allowed day. Empty means: all day.
data_description.time_to: May be earlier than the start, e.g. overnight 22:00–6:00.
data_description.entities: Devices to control and sensors whose value the guest should see (e.g. a temperature).

data.name: Name for the guest
data.show_state: Show the state to the guest

data_description.type: A switch has On and Off buttons. A button must be held for a second, e.g. for a gate. A read-out only shows the state, without control.
data_description.action: Only used for the Button kind.
data_description.pulse_seconds: For the Pulse action: how long the entity stays on.
data_description.max_uses: Empty means: no limit. Not used for read-outs.
data_description.show_state: The guest sees e.g. “State: on” above the buttons.

control_read.title: Control {index} of {total}: {entity}
control_read.description: The guest sees the current value of `{entity_id}` (e.g. a temperature), without any control.

error.too_many: A panel can have at most 20 controls.
error.bad_duration: Duration must be at least one minute.
error.bad_pin: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
error.hours_pair: Set both hours (from and to), or neither.
error.hours_equal: The from and to hours must differ.
error.bad_dates: The panel must end in the future.
error.portal_error: The portal refused the panel. Check the HA log.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the portal. Try again in a moment.
error.bad_domain: This entity cannot be shared with guests.
error.button_only: This entity can only be a button.
error.not_readable: This entity cannot be shown to a guest.
error.read_only: This entity can only be shown, not controlled.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not running. Check the portal connection.

disconnected.title: No connection to the access portal
disconnected.description: “{name}” has not been able to reach the portal {url} for over 15 minutes. Guests cannot control devices right now. Check the internet connection; the integration keeps retrying.

create_panel.name: Create guest panel
create_panel.description: Creates a time-limited panel and returns its link and PIN.

title.name: Title
title.description: Shown to the guest, e.g. Access for Mark.

controls.name: Controls
controls.description: List of entities: entity_id, optional name, type (switch/button/sensor), action (press, run, unlock, open, toggle, pulse), pulse_seconds, max_uses, show_state.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: Start of access. Now if empty.

valid_until.name: Valid until
valid_until.description: End of access. Use this or duration.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Length of access from the start. 24 hours if neither this nor valid until is set.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days of the week when access works. Every day if empty.

time_to.name: To (HH:MM)
time_to.description: Daily end of access hours. May be earlier than From for overnight access.

language.name: Language
language.description: Default language of the guest page.

notify.name: Show notification
notify.description: Show the link and PIN as a notification in Home Assistant.

config_entry_id.name: Portal connection
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one portal connection.

config_entry_id.name: Portal connection
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one portal connection.
